name: SafeSnap – Effortless WordPress Backups
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
SafeSnap makes WordPress backups simple and stress-free! Automatic daily backups, one-click restore, and beautiful dashboard to monitor your site’s protection.

🌟 Key Features (Free)

  • ⏰ Automatic Daily Backups – Runs every 24 hours automatically (both database AND files!)
  • 💾 One-Click Manual Backups – Create full backups (database + files) anytime
  • 🔄 Easy Restore – Restore your entire site with one click
  • 📦 Complete Backups – Database AND files (themes, plugins, uploads) backed up together
  • 🗂️ 7-Day Retention – Automatic cleanup of old backups
  • 🔒 Secure Storage – Backups stored safely in wp-content/uploads
  • 📊 Beautiful Dashboard – Modern interface with backup statistics
  • ⏰ Next Backup Countdown – See when your next automatic backup runs
  • ⚡ Lightning Fast – Optimized backup process
  • 🆓 100% Free – Core features completely free forever

What Gets Backed Up?

Database:
* All WordPress tables
* Posts, pages, comments
* Users and settings
* Custom post types
* WooCommerce data (if installed)
* Everything in your database!

Files:
* All themes (wp-content/themes/)
* All plugins (wp-content/plugins/)
* All uploads (wp-content/uploads/)
* Custom files in wp-content

Automatic Backups – Set It and Forget It!

Once activated, SafeSnap automatically:
1. Creates a full backup every 24 hours
2. Backs up BOTH database AND files
3. Deletes backups older than 7 days
4. Shows you when the next backup runs

You don’t need to do anything – it just works!
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “SafeSnap”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Done! Daily backups start automatically

No configuration needed! SafeSnap works immediately.
sections.faq:
Do backups run automatically?

YES! Once activated, SafeSnap creates automatic backups every 24 hours. Both database AND files are backed up. You can see when the next backup runs on the dashboard.

What gets backed up?

Both database AND files:
* Database: All tables, posts, settings, everything
* Files: Themes, plugins, uploads (everything in wp-content)

Where are backups stored?

Backups are stored in /wp-content/uploads/safesnap/backups/ on your server. This directory is protected with .htaccess to prevent web access.

How do I restore a backup?

Click “Restore” next to any backup in the dashboard. You can restore:
* Database only
* Files only
* Both (complete restore)
